plain.what: Reads candidate CVs natively with multimodal AI and calculates job match score.
plain.when: A candidate drops their resume on your intake dropzone.
plain.result: A verified score out of 100, identified core skills, and an updated ATS sheet.

sample.Gemini reads the CV: Parsed PDF via Gemini 2.0 Flash Vision with JSON schema enforcement
sample.Extract score and skills: Extracted match score: 88%. Skills: n8n, Make.com, Vapi, Paystack
sample.Log candidate to ATS: Appended record to Google Sheets / Airtable ATS
sample.Show score on site: Returned score 88 and skills to the interactive score ring

toolNotes.n8n: Best choice: accepts raw PDF binary buffers directly without 3rd-party OCR converters.
toolNotes.make: Requires a Google Drive / PDF extraction module before passing text to OpenAI.
toolNotes.zapier: Limited file size handling and costly AI step add-ons.
